intent: Focused overlay dialog for confirmations or short secondary tasks.
useWhen: Short forms or messages that block the page briefly
doNotUseWhen: Full-page flows — use a dedicated route
Passive help text — use Tooltip or Field hint
doNot: Do not invent local Modal or Dialog
Do not nest Scoreboard or Table layouts inside modals without reason
